name: Tirzah
overview: The name Tirzah appears in Scripture both as one of the daughters of Zelophehad, who, lacking brothers, petitioned for and received a special inheritance among their family, demonstrating God's just provision for His people (Numbers 26:33; 27:1; 36:11; Joshua 17:3-4). Additionally, Tirzah was a prominent city in Canaan, captured during Joshua's conquest, which later became a royal residence for the northern kingdom of Israel and served as a military base under King Menahem, noted for its beauty and strategic importance (Joshua 12:24). These references highlight both God's care for individual families and His sovereign establishment of His people in the land.
